import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*t) + p[4]*t)
    amp = p[5] + p[6]*t
    K = p[7]*np.exp(p[8]*t)
    S = A**p[9]/(K**p[9] + A**p[9])
    return base + amp*S
